equations.section: 6. The Observer as a Bounded System
equations.meaning: The canonical observer-pipeline equation: a manifested model of event E is formed by selective uptake S_A, then encoding/reporting Pi_A, then translation T_A into a usable model; without selection, encoding, and translation, no well-defined observer is present.

equations.section: 6. The Observer as a Bounded System
equations.text: Know_A(W) = 1 iff Dist(R_A[n], R_A^nu[n]) <= epsilon_K for all admissible variations nu on the declared window W
equations.meaning: Defines knowledge as stabilized representation: a representation counts as known when its distance from the same representation under any admissible variation stays within a tolerance, over a declared window W.
